mapper.select: SELECT e.pending_operation_id,e.container_id,e.container_started_at, (SELECT s.id FROM pf.workspace_environment_stop_receipt s WHERE s.space_id=e.space_id AND s.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND s.environment_id=e.id AND s.generation=e.generation AND s.container_id=e.container_id AND s.image_id=e.image_id AND s.container_started_at=e.container_started_at AND s.exec_stopped AND s.callbacks_stopped ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS prior_stop_receipt_id, o.protocol,o.cleanup_state FROM pf.workspace_environment e JOIN pf.workspace_environment_operation o ON o.id=e.operation_id WHERE e.id=#{environmentId}
SELECT id,kind,status FROM pf.workspace_environment_use WHERE environment_id=#{environmentId} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_operation WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND status IN('PENDING','CLAIMED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN'))

SELECT o.id AS operation_id,COALESCE(o.lifecycle_intent,o.kind) AS intent,o.status,o.generation, e.version FROM pf.workspace_environment_idempotency i JOIN pf.workspace_environment_operation o ON o.id=i.operation_id JOIN pf.workspace_environment e ON e.id=i.environment_id WHERE i.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND i.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND i.request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_environment_operation(id,space_id,workspace_id,environment_id,kind,initiator, actor_id,command_id,generation,fence,status,protocol,lifecycle_intent,target_creation_command_id, target_creation_fence,target_image_id,target_policy_hash,target_project_id,target_container_id, target_container_started_at,prior_stop_receipt_id,cleanup_required,cleanup_state) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.spaceId},#{row.workspaceId},#{row.environmentId},#{row.kind},'USER',#{row.actorId}, #{row.commandId},#{row.generation},#{row.fence},#{row.status},'ENVIRONMENT_V3',#{row.kind}, #{row.creationCommandId},#{row.creationFence},#{row.imageId},#{row.policyHash},#{row.projectId}, #{row.containerId},#{row.containerStartedAt},#{row.priorStopReceiptId}, #{row.kind}<>'WAKE',CASE WHEN #{row.kind}='WAKE' THEN 'NOT_REQUIRED' ELSE 'PENDING' END)
mapper.select: SELECT id,space_id,workspace_id,environment_id,actor_id,command_id,generation,fence,kind,status, target_creation_command_id AS creation_command_id,target_creation_fence AS creation_fence, target_image_id AS image_id,target_policy_hash AS policy_hash,target_project_id AS project_id, target_container_id AS container_id,target_container_started_at AS container_started_at,prior_stop_receipt_id FROM pf.workspace_environment_operation WHERE id=#{operationId} AND protocol='ENVIRONMENT_V3' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_use SET cancel_requested=true,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND kind NOT LIKE 'FILE_%' AND NOT cancel_requested

UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_operation SET fence=#{fence},status='PENDING',prior_stop_receipt_id=#{priorStopId},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{operationId} AND protocol='ENVIRONMENT_V3' AND status='DRAINING' AND owner_id IS NULL AND kind IN('SLEEP','DELETE')
UPDATE pf.workspace SET environment_state=#{phase},version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND id=#{row.workspaceId} AND state='READY'
